v0.1.0.description:
This is the initial unstable release:

- Location checks for progress within levels ("checkpoints" / completions).
- 16 achievements can also be locations.
- Collect "Quadcopter Piece"s (placeholder name) to unlock a goal area.
- Unlock "abilities", for hole-based effects and items to catapult.
- A few levels can have special items/locations within them (Snake Danger, Salt & Pepper).
- Mostly functional UT support.
- A few fun traps / filler items.
- Some extra QOL features for dialog and achievements.
- And some yaml settings that can cause generation failure!
v0.1.0.title: DonutCountyAP v0.1.0

v0.1.1.description:
World:
- **Fix some achievements not requiring their dependant item.**
- Add more info to world documentation, including Linux setup instructions.
- Rename some entrances and item categories.

Client:
- **Fix an issue preventing connection to a slot if it has received items.**
- Buffer and re-send location checks in the case of sudden server disconnects.
- Store some more tracker-adjacent data on the server.
- Fix the claw machine secret code triggering many times.
- Prevent quacking when you can't text.

The client is partially compatible with 0.1.0 worlds, some in-logic locations may be unreachable.
v0.1.1.title: DonutCountyAP v0.1.1
